topic.source_contract: Waste planning, environmental-permit and compliance evidence

facts.role: planning framework for waste infrastructure and waste hierarchy
facts.guard: policy is not a site permit or capacity result
route availability is not an issued permit

facts.activities: storage, treatment, transfer and mobile plant

facts.principle: waste replaces non-waste material to perform a function
facts.guard: recovery plan is not accepted permit or completed works
compliance score is not planning status, land value or future viability

scope_guards: Waste planning permission and an Environment Agency permit are distinct decisions.
RPS, exemption, standard-rules and bespoke-permit routes remain distinct.
An application, consultation or recovery plan is not an issued or operational permit.
A permit does not establish HMLR title, planning permission or spare waste capacity.
Deposit for recovery requires evidence of a genuine recovery function and is not ordinary disposal by assertion.
Permit-compliance scoring records regulatory performance and is not a parcel development score.
Historic or nearby waste activity is not proof of current contamination, nuisance or remediation liability.
No score or promotion is written without exact planning, permit, operator, waste type, capacity and site evidence.
